kyoto_il_tobanchi_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta and pizza are central (2024–26 reviews); an ajillo, seseri sautéed in lemon butter and an appetizer platter of potato salad, ratatouille and pâté also appear (November 2025).
kyoto_il_tobanchi_sanjo.vegan_detail: Ask. Ratatouille on the appetizer platter (November 2025) and grilled Manganji peppers (topped with cheese, August 2026); most dishes have meat, seafood or cheese.
kyoto_il_tobanchi_sanjo.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–22:30 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sundays, or the following Monday when it is a substitute holiday (Tabelog). Often fully booked — book ahead (2025–26 reviews). One drink per person; cards only for bills of ¥4,000 or more; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 31 seats: counter of 7 and tables on the ground floor, tables and a sofa upstairs (Tabelog); a November 2025 reviewer booking through a reservation site saw a ¥7,000 minimum spend for second-floor tables. Dogs welcome inside and on the terrace: say the size and number of dogs when booking, bring a café mat, diapers and a leash; dogs may come in a cart; the shop takes no responsibility for animal allergies or accidents (Tabelog). Children welcome; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Ogawa-dori just south of Sanjo, about 10 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_il_tobanchi_sanjo.notes: [Italian · Ogawa-Sanjo] A renovated machiya near Nijo Castle where dogs sit in with their owners: an appetizer platter, pizzas and pastas, wine by the bottle, and dog meals too. Often fully booked; about ¥4,000–6,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 2 July 2012 (Tabelog). A stylish renovation of a Kyoto townhouse (November 2024 and March 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Appetizer platter; pasta and pizza; dog-friendly dining.

anecdotes.text: In November 2024, when a couple said they were dining with their dog, the meat came without salt and pepper.
A June 2026 traveller's dog came in a cart, so the staff set a table on the ground floor.
A February 2026 pair found the pasta too salty and the appetizer platter disappointing — about ¥9,000 for two with pizza and three drinks — but were glad to sit indoors with their dog.
A November 2025 diner felt the background music, with ad breaks, did not suit the room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: IL TOBANCHI (イル トバンキ)、バル・イタリアン・バー、中京区小川通三条下る猩々町123、月〜土・祝日 18:00〜22:30 (L.O. 21:30)、日曜休み (振替休日は翌月曜休み)、お1人様1ドリンク制、カードは4,000円以上、31席、犬と一緒に入れる (カフェマット、犬用のおむつ、リード)、犬用のごはん、2012年7月2日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 町家を改装、前菜の盛り合わせ7種、ゴルゴンゾーラのクリームパスタ、カルボナーラ、ピザ、飲み放題つきのコース5,500円 (2025年12月)、満席のことが多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Friendly staff, to dog owners and others alike (March 2025 review); phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_soan_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. The pho is made with domestic rice noodles, and the menu’s allergen notes for the plain and chicken pho list chicken and seafood but not wheat; the bobun, vegan bún and rice palette set list wheat. No gluten-free claim or cross-contact information is published (Tabelog menu, updated September 2026).
kyoto_soan_gojo.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: a Vegan Bún (¥1,760), crisp seasonal vegetables in a black-vinegar sauce with herb salad, described on the menu as for vegans and as a summer dish — ask whether it is still on; Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options. The pho broth is made from chicken bones (Tabelog menu, updated September 2026).
kyoto_soan_gojo.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and café 15:00–18:00 (last order 17:00); Tabelog lists Thursday, Friday and Saturday open and Monday–Wednesday and Sunday closed; the official site gives irregular closing days and posts opening days on Instagram; closed on public holidays (Tabelog). Dinner after 18:00 on a special schedule (Tabelog); 18:00–22:00 by advance reservation only (Leaf Kyoto, December 2025). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 20 seats; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Takeaway available (Tabelog). About 5 minutes from Gojo subway station (official site).
kyoto_soan_gojo.notes: [Café · Gojo-Takakura, pho and rice palettes] A café, shop and gallery opened in late 2025 to share good food from around Japan: rice-noodle pho with low-temperature chicken, Asian-style egg rice and ‘Rice Palette’ sets, plus a vegan bún in summer. English-speaking staff. Thursday–Saturday; check Instagram.

roles: Culinary director and food adviser (official site); runs そ・かわひがし in Kyoto (official site)
chef_bio.background: SOAN opened on 30 November 2025 as a “destination store” with four parts — FOOD (dining), TOOLS (shop), LEARNING (classes) and JOURNEY (travel ideas) — on the theme of discovering and sharing deliciousness (official site; Leaf Kyoto, December 2025; January 2026 review). Leaf Kyoto credits its photo to Release, a general incorporated association, whose domain the site uses. The culinary director, 中東篤志 of そ・かわひがし, has shaped the menu with the team since the concept stage (official site); a January 2026 reviewer adds that the menu follows the 24 solar terms.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Table to Arts & Earth”: discovering and sharing deliciousness (official site); all meals made with safe, carefully chosen ingredients and seasonings (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: In October 2026 a diner who came back for the bobun found the limited dish gone and had the chicken pho set instead; the cutlery case held spoons but no chopsticks, which staff brought on request, and staff asked about cilantro before serving.
A December 2025 reviewer had a SOAN bento before an event and called it authentic ethnic food with tasty vegetables.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: SOAN、Table to Arts＆Earth 「美味しい」の発見と共有、京都府京都市下京区五条高倉堺町21番地ジムキノウエダビルディング1階101号、地下鉄五条駅から徒歩5分、京阪清水五条駅から徒歩6分、ランチ11:00〜14:00 (13:30 L.O.)、カフェ15:00〜18:00 (17:00 L.O.)、不定休 (営業日はInstagramで)、2025年11月30日グランドオープン、ライスパレット、カリナリーディレクターは京都「そ・かわひがし」の中東篤志 (コンセプト段階からメニュー開発)。食べログ: SOAN、カフェ・創作料理、木・金・土営業、月・火・水・日と祝日は休み、18時以降のディナーは特別営業、カード・電子マネー・QR可、20席、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、テイクアウト可、英語対応スタッフ、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン対応、アレルギー表示あり。食べログのメニュー (2026年9月更新、英語): SOANのフォー (国産米粉麺、低温調理の鶏、自家製ハーブオイル) とアジア風卵かけご飯 (Awaji の卵) のセット1,650円、えびフォーのセット1,870円、ライスパレットのセット1,980円 (Iiyama の米)、Vegan Bún 1,760円 (夏の一品)、SOAN Bobun 1,870円、マンゴーチェー770円、自家製プリン550円。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ライスパレットとお米のポタージュ、SOAN Bobun、鶏フォー、お弁当。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff (Tabelog); check Instagram for opening days.

positives.text: A Vegan Bún labelled on the menu as for vegans (a summer dish; allergens wheat, soy, peanuts); Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog (menu updated September 2026); reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kazeya_sugihara.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, Saikyo-miso-grilled fish, tempura, fried dishes and set meals; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_kazeya_sugihara.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-focused izakaya; set meals come with miso soup (official site; reviews).
kyoto_kazeya_sugihara.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–13:30 (one part of the official site says 14:00; Tabelog 13:30), no lunch bookings; dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Sunday and Monday, with occasional other closures (official site; Tabelog). Phone bookings 14:00–22:00; courses must be booked three days ahead (official site). Payment: cash (official site); Tabelog lists QR payments, no cards. Counter, table seats, tatami room and private room (official site). All seats non-smoking (official site); Tabelog still lists smoking allowed. On Muromachi south of Rokkaku, near Hankyu Karasuma and subway Shijo (official site).
kyoto_kazeya_sugihara.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma, fish and sake] A calm, grown-up izakaya past a reception area: counter, booths and tatami rooms. Lunch sets around ¥1,000–1,600 (seafood bowl, sashimi, dashimaki); at night sashimi, simmered and grilled fish, tempura, and courses from ¥5,500. Cash. Closed Sunday and Monday.

roles: Okami (not named; makes the shibazuke, official site)
chef_bio.background: A local izakaya on Muromachi focused on fish, sake from around Japan and about twenty shochu (official site). A January 2025 reviewer has come for seven or eight years, drawn by the owner’s personality.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; squid-ink yaki-somen with shibazuke.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner booked the same day, found singing crickets on display by the entrance, and saw the counter and booths fill, mostly with older customers.
In January 2018 a New Year guest was surprised to be served o-toso to start.
A January 2025 New Year party noted that the all-you-can-drink option had ended.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 口馳八丁 風屋杉原 (かぜやすぎはら)、京都府京都市中京区室町通六角下ル鯉山町514 アトラクタービル1F、お昼11:30〜13:30 (別の箇所では14:00)、夜17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、日曜・月曜定休 (臨時休業あり)、予約受付14:00〜22:00、昼の予約不可、現金、全席禁煙、座敷・個室・カウンター、全国の厳選日本酒、焼酎約20種、お造り盛り合わせ、出し巻玉子、女将手作りの柴漬入りいかすみ焼そうめん、鰆西京焼き、天ぷら盛り合わせ、昼は日替わり定食・海鮮丼・お造り定食・出し巻定食・唐揚定食、大皿コース5,500円〜・会席コース6,600円〜 (税込、飲み物別、3日前までに電話予約)、季節により鍋も。食べログ: 居酒屋・寿司、火〜土 11:30〜13:30・17:30〜21:30、日・月休み、カード不可、QR決済可、喫煙可の表示。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): あん肝と白和え、新じゃがといかの塩辛の揚げもの、鯛の山椒煮、鯖の西京焼き、海鮮丼1,600円、日替わり定食1,000円、お造り定食1,200円、店主の人柄、入口に鳴く虫、お屠蘇、飲み放題は終了、奥の座敷。

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog; reviews dated through February 2026.

kyoto_yakiniku_terusan.gf_detail: Ask. Marinated kalbi, yaki-shabu and yaki-suki, chijimi, cold noodles and stone-grilled bibimbap; no gluten information is published (gurunavi; reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_terusan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef yakiniku house (gurunavi).
kyoto_yakiniku_terusan.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 daily (last order 21:30), closed irregularly (Tabelog; gurunavi). Groups of 10 or more book by phone (Tabelog); private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 38 seats: 4 at the counter, 18 at sunken kotatsu tatami seats, 16 at tables (Tabelog). The ground floor is non-smoking; the second floor is a smoking area, closed to under-20s and pregnant guests (Tabelog). Children welcome, with a children’s menu, tableware and chairs (Tabelog). Takeaway samgyetang, oxtail soup and yukgaejang (gurunavi). On Fuyacho south of Nijo, about 5 minutes from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae exit 9 (Tabelog). Opened 17 October 2011 (Tabelog; gurunavi).
kyoto_yakiniku_terusan.notes: [Yakiniku · Fuyacho-Nijo, Kyoto beef since 2011] A spacious house-style yakiniku restaurant with counter, sunken kotatsu tatami seats and tables: Kyoto and Tamba beef, the house yaki-shabu, pot-marinated kalbi to wrap in Kyoto vegetables, chijimi and cold noodles. Non-smoking downstairs; the upstairs floor allows smoking.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 17 October 2011 (Tabelog; gurunavi). The house offers selected Kyoto-area beef — the gurunavi page variously says Kyotanba beef, Tamba wagyu and Kyoto beef — with wine, in an adult hideaway atmosphere (gurunavi).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner came late after work, found the room quiet, and rated the meat fresh and varied, though the staff seemed a little low on energy.
A February 2024 farewell party took the second floor for a course that started with chuck-eye roll and ended with stone-grilled bibimbap.
A July 2024 visitor liked the white rice best and found the meat good but pricey for Kyoto, the kimchi portion small, and no raw-meat dishes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ぐるなび: 焼肉 天照杉 てるさん (ヤキニクテルサン)、大人の隠れ家的雰囲気、厳選した極上の京丹波牛 (別の箇所では丹波和牛、京都牛)、焼肉に合うワイン、2011年10月17日オープン、ディナー17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、不定休、38席、掘りごたつ席、天照杉の焼きしゃぶ1,980円、壺漬け熟成カルビ (包み京野菜＆味噌付) 1,408円、天照杉の焼すき1,980円、贅沢！厚切りランプ、宴会コース4,000円〜、テイクアウトはサムゲタン・テールスープ・ユッケジャンスープ。食べログ: 焼肉・韓国料理・居酒屋、京都市中京区麩屋町通り二条下る尾張町236-1、毎日17:00〜22:00、不定休、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、38席 (カウンター4、掘りごたつ18、テーブル16)、1階禁煙・2階喫煙 (20歳未満と妊婦は不可)、10名以上は電話予約、貸切20名まで、子ども歓迎。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 厚切りの肉、好みの厚さの牛タン、山わさび、冷麺、チヂミ、ナムル、いかとにらのチヂミ、石焼ビビンバの締め、白ご飯、価格は高め、店員の元気が今ひとつ (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Ground floor non-smoking; upstairs allows smoking.

existence.note: Tabelog and gurunavi listings; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_shutei_sasakura.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, fried turban shell with liver and butter-soy, plain yakisoba, karaage and curry rice bowls; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_shutei_sasakura.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); may close early after 22:00, so call ahead; closed Tuesday (Tabelog; June 2025 review). In 2016: 17:30–22:00 last order, closed Tuesday (Serai, October 2016 issue). No prices on the menu (November 2024). Cash only (Tabelog; September 2026). Counter seating only (2024–2026 reviews); in 2016, 12 counter seats and 6 at a table (Serai). Booking recommended; full on a Friday in September 2026. Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a lane off Oike, about 5 minutes from Karasuma-Oike subway station (Tabelog), marked by a cedar ball (November 2025).
kyoto_shutei_sasakura.notes: [Izakaya · Karasuma-Oike, a former sushi chef since about 1990] A Showa-era counter down a dim lane, run by an elderly couple: the owner, once a sushi chef and a sake sommelier, still buys and cuts the fish daily. Order the sazae three ways and the plain yakisoba. No prices on the menu; cash; book ahead. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A former sushi chef who had run the bar near Oike for 27 years at age 68 (Serai, October 2016 issue). Reviewers give the founding as 1990 and the owner’s age as 77 (November 2025; foodle, March 2026). Reviewers in October 2026 describe the shop as run by a couple, “an elderly couple”; a June 2025 reviewer thanks both the chef and the owner for the service.
chef_bio.philosophy: Daily sourcing; the fish of the day (2025 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Sazae karaage three ways; plain yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: Asked in November 2025 about the plain yakisoba, the owner laughed that the seasoning is a company secret.
A November 2024 group wandered in off the dim lane, found no prices on the menu, and paid about ¥6,000 each after a long spread.
An October 2026 diner who arrived at opening heard that a booking from overseas visitors was coming later.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: サライ (2016年10月号、2017年10月web掲載): 笹蔵、寿司職人だった西村陽三さん (68歳) が御池通近くで酒亭を始めて27年、由良の赤ウニ3,500円、ポテトサラダ600円、とり肝ソース漬け600円、素焼きそば700円、17時30分〜22時 (最終注文)、火曜定休、カウンター12席・テーブル6席、5,000円〜、予約が好ましい、京都市中京区御池通間ノ町上ル高田町509-4。foodle (2026年3月): 大将は今年77歳、元寿司職人で利き酒師、創業1990年、30年以上、生ダコ、本ししゃも、ポテトサラダ、ペッパーくもこ、サザエからあげ、素焼きそば。食べログ: 酒亭 笹蔵、居酒屋・海鮮・創作料理、月・水〜日 18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、22時以降は早じまいの場合あり、火曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営むカウンターだけの店、昭和レトロ、サザエの唐揚げを三通りで、素焼きそば、たこのお造り、お造り盛り合わせ、カレー丼、博多鍋、生わさびのご飯、ポテトサラダ、値段のないメニュー、現金のみ、金曜は満席。

cultural_comfort.note: No prices on the menu; cash only; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_shutei_sasakura.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26002593/ (35.011346, 135.761912); not pin-checked by the worker; 2026-11-26

kyoto_cafe_de_505_momak.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fresh pasta of 100% durum semolina (museum page), sandwiches and bread with the sets (2025–26 reviews). No gluten-free option mentioned.
kyoto_cafe_de_505_momak.vegan_detail: Not vegan: carbonara with pancetta and egg yolk, bacon tomato pasta, egg sandwiches, ice cream (museum page; 2025–26 reviews). The house soy milk pudding’s other ingredients are not stated; ask.
kyoto_cafe_de_505_momak.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 10:00–18:00; Fridays during special exhibitions 10:00–19:00; last order 30 minutes before closing; closed Monday, and when Monday is a holiday it follows the museum, opening that day and closing the next (museum page, read 2026-11-26). Tabelog lists 10:00–17:30, Tuesday to Sunday. No seat reservations (museum page). No museum ticket needed for the café (museum page; November 2025). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 40 seats, terrace seats non-smoking (Tabelog). Breakfast 10:00–11:00 (May and September 2026). Busy at lunch and during popular exhibitions (November 2025; November 2026); in May 2026 a reviewer saw groups waiting while the room was about 60% full. Room for strollers and wheelchairs (September 2026).
kyoto_cafe_de_505_momak.notes: [Café · Okazaki] The café on the first floor of the National Museum of Modern Art, by the great torii of Heian Shrine: glass walls and a shaded terrace over the Lake Biwa Canal, fresh pasta, breakfast sets before 11:00 and dishes tied to the current exhibition. No museum ticket needed; closed Monday; no reservations.

chef_bio.background: The café of the National Museum of Modern Art, Kyoto: a glass-walled café facing the Lake Biwa Canal with an open terrace, popular in cherry-blossom season for the trees along the canal (museum page).
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh pasta of 100% durum semolina from a pasta machine imported from Italy (museum page).

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular who usually comes for coffee called it the favourite of all museum cafés for its setting, and found cushions laid on the terrace chairs.
A September 2026 visitor, tired from a crowded holiday bus, found the café nearly empty before 11:00 and stumbled on the breakfast menu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 京都国立近代美術館公式サイト: café de 505 (カフェ・ド・ゴマルゴ)、琵琶湖疏水に面したガラス張りのカフェ、オープンテラス、観覧チケットなしで利用可、午前10時〜午後6時 (金曜日の企画展開催中は午後7時まで)、ラストオーダーは閉店30分前、月曜休み (祝日の場合は開館に準じて営業し翌日休業)、座席の予約不可、デュラムセモリナ粉100%の生パスタ、ベーコンのトマトソースパスタ1,180円、カルボナーラ仕立て1,550円、自家製豆乳プリン700円、白川〜みつ豆と十勝小豆〜750円、コーヒー550円。食べログ: カフェ、左京区岡崎円勝寺 京都国立近代美術館内、40席。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年11月、英語): 朝食のオープンサンドセット760円、展覧会コラボメニュー、焼きカレー、白ワイン600円。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the table; cards and QR accepted. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Museum’s official café page; Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_cafe_de_505_momak.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26000914/ (35.012314, 135.782032); not cross-checked (worker, no OSM this round); 2026-11-26

kyoto_tato_marutamachi.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim. Paella, Iberico ham, marinated octopus and Greek salad are on the menu, but so are bread, bread skewers and Spanish crepes (2025 reviews); nothing is said about how dishes are made.
kyoto_tato_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Iberico ham, mussels, sardines, squid with anchovy, spinach gratin, cheesecake (2023–25 reviews). No plant-based dishes mentioned.
kyoto_tato_marutamachi.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–22:00; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reviewers say the opening time is relaxed, so arrive a little after opening (June 2023, September 2025); closures and new dishes are posted on the shop’s Instagram (September 2023). Reservations taken (Tabelog; a September 2023 reviewer booked a weekend evening); private hire from 12 people (July 2025). Visa and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). A standing area and tables (September 2025). The owner cooks alone, so orders take time; paella takes a while, so order it early (September 2023, January and May 2024). Formerly near Teramachi / Kawaramachi, it moved to Marutamachi (April 2022, May 2024).
kyoto_tato_marutamachi.notes: [Spanish bar · Marutamachi] A small, lively, cheerful Spanish bar where the Spanish owner, Tato, cooks alone and talks in Kansai dialect; guests from abroad pin their home town on a world map. Iberico ham, home-style dishes such as “Mother’s Spinach Gratin”, and paella if you order early. Evenings from 17:00, opening time relaxed.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a Spanish owner who has lived in Japan for over 20 years (September 2025) and speaks lively Kansai dialect (April 2022, July 2025); the bar was near Teramachi Shopping Street a few years before 2022, then moved to Marutamachi, and started serving coffee after the move (April 2022). Tato runs the place solo (September 2023); in January 2024 a woman also welcomed guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Iberico ham, home-style Spanish dishes, paella.

anecdotes.text: A September 2023 reviewer: when guests from abroad come in, the owner greets them in their own languages, and anyone who says where they are from puts a pin on the world map.
In July 2025, with the room almost to themselves, a group heard Tato’s stories of Spain and Barcelona; the music went down when the talk got deep.

A September 2025 pair, after a long night of wine and dishes at ¥22,920 for two, called it the most cheerful restaurant in Kyoto and advised coming as a second stop, the energy runs so high from opening to close.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スペイン料理、上京区信冨町317-2、神宮丸太町から391m、毎日17:00〜22:00、不定休、予約可、貸切可、カード (VISA)・QR (PayPay) 可、電子マネー不可。口コミ (2022年4月〜2025年12月、英語): 関西弁で話すスペイン人のオーナー Tato が一人で切り盛り、日本に20年以上、寺町の近くから丸太町に移転、メニューは「リキッド」と「ソリッド」、イベリコ豚の生ハム、「母のほうれん草グラタン」、ムール貝の蒸し煮、パエリア、世界地図にピンを刺す習わし、開店時間はゆるやか、貸切は12名から。

cultural_comfort.note: The Spanish owner chats in Japanese and greets guests from abroad in their own languages (September 2023). Whether that includes English is not stated.

kyoto_astrea_coffee.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fruit press sandwiches, granola, brownie and gateau basque (site; 2025–26 reviews). No gluten-free option mentioned.
kyoto_astrea_coffee.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sandwiches with cream cheese, granola with yogurt, brownie with ice cream, milk drinks (site; 2025–26 reviews). No plant milk mentioned.
kyoto_astrea_coffee.hours_raw: Daily 7:30–15:00; closing days may vary (Tabelog; the shop’s site gives 7:30–15:00). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). Opened 16 March 2019 (Tabelog). A small white room full of plants, with counter seats; few seats inside (May 2026, January 2026); only one seat left at 8:00 on an August 2026 morning. No phone calls or online meetings inside (January 2026). Windows and doors stand wide open, so dress warmly in the cold months (November 2025). Some items are limited in number each day (site). Takeaway coffee too (August and September 2026). Children and dogs seen with their owners (July 2025, August 2026).
kyoto_astrea_coffee.notes: [Coffee · Shijo-Omiya] A small, plant-filled white coffee stand in a quiet back street, open from 7:30: Australian-style espresso, latte art and a seasonal fruit press sandwich (fig, strawberry) or peach granola. Few seats; no calls or laptop meetings.

chef_bio.background: A specialty coffee stand opened on 16 March 2019 (Tabelog; site). Per reviews: espresso in the Australian style (March 2025); the owner recommends drinks to regulars (September 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fruit press sandwiches and homemade granola with whole fruit.

anecdotes.text: A regular of six visits comes back every season for the fruit sandwich series: fig in September 2025 and August 2026, peach granola in August 2025 and July 2026, and early-morning coffee in March 2025.
A January 2026 visitor on a business trip liked the latte so much that another one went to the manager at the client’s office as a takeaway gift.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: コーヒースタンド、下京区橘町31-1、毎日7:30〜15:00、定休日は変動あり、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、カウンター席、オープン日2019年3月16日。公式サイト: astrea coffee kyoto、7:30〜15:00、桃のグラノーラ、いちじくとクリームチーズのサンド、日によって提供数に限り。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年9月、英語): オーストラリアスタイルのエスプレッソ、カフェラテ600円、コールドブリュー550円、フルーツサンド、桃のグラノーラ1,500円、植物の多い白い店内、席は少なめ、通話やオンライン会議は不可、11月は窓と扉が開いている、接客が物足りなかったとの声 (2025年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; cards and e-money accepted. March and May 2025 reviewers saw many overseas visitors; an August 2026 one saw few. No English evidence found.

kyoto_kamogawa_seimenjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon (made with Kyoto matcha), tempura, chuka soba (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kamogawa_seimenjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: udon broth (dashi base not stated), chicken tempura, chikuwa tempura, chashu on the chuka soba (2026 reviews). Vegetable tempura (pumpkin, sweet potato, eggplant) is on the menu; ask about the broth and the frying oil.
kyoto_kamogawa_seimenjo.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:00, holidays included (Tabelog). Opened 7 May 2020 (Tabelog). Half self-service: order and pay at the counter, take the udon to your seat, as at Marugame Seimen (August 2026); staff check a table is free before taking the order (November 2026). Reservations, take-out and delivery (Tabelog). All cards, iD and QUICPay, PayPay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 36 seats, sofa seats, wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). A 30-second walk east from Keihan Shichijo station (Tabelog); near Sanjusangendo (August 2026). No waiting at weekday lunch (August 2026).
kyoto_kamogawa_seimenjo.notes: [Udon · Shichijo] A roomy half-self-service udon shop by Keihan Shichijo station, a short walk from Sanjusangendo: thin, chewy udon tinted green with Kyoto matcha, hot or ice-cold, with tempura to add, from ¥650. Open 11:00–21:00 daily; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 May 2020 near Keihan Shichijo station as a half-self-service udon shop built on Kyoto matcha udon (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the listing: “Delicious, affordable, and quick!”
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha udon made with Kyoto matcha, without colouring (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor from Sanjusangendo was greeted “Irasshaimase!” by a staff member from abroad and seen off with “Ookini!”, which felt heartwarming.
A September 2026 visitor walking by the river was drawn in by the sign for sudachi udon and found it covered in thin sudachi slices.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うどん、東山区七条通り鞘町西入ル日吉町228、京阪七条駅から徒歩30秒、毎日11:00〜21:00、予約可、テイクアウト・デリバリー可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、36席、ソファ席、車いす可、子ども連れ可、英語・簡体字メニュー、英語を話すスタッフ、オープン日2020年5月7日。店の紹介: 京都の抹茶を練り込んだ着色料なしの抹茶うどん、やや細めの麺、40年愛されるぶっかけうどん。口コミ (2026年7月〜11月、英語): ざるうどん650円、かけうどん650円、鶏天180円、すだちうどん、湯葉うどん、山かけうどん、中華そば、注文して先に払いうどんを受け取るセルフ式。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Simplified Chinese menus with photos and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); order at the counter.
